verses.en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.pt: Então Davi teve conselho com os capitães de milhares e de centenas, e com todos os chefes.
verses.en_web: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
verses.en_bbe: Then David had discussions with the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds and with every chief.

verses.en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
verses.pt: E Davi disse a todo a congregação de Israel: Se bem vos parece, e se vem do SENHOR nosso Deus, enviemos depressa mensageiros aos nossos irmãos que restaram em todas as terras de Israel, aos sacerdotes e aos levitas que estão com eles em suas cidades e em seus arredores, para que se ajuntem conosco.
verses.en_web: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let us send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have suburbs, that they may gather themselves to us.
verses.en_bbe: And David said to all the men of Israel who had come together there, If it seems good to you and if it is the purpose of the Lord our God, let us send to all the rest of our brothers, everywhere in the land of Israel, and to the priests and the Levites in their towns and the country round them, and get them to come together here to us;

verses.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
verses.pt: E tragamos de volta a nós a arca de nosso Deus, porque não a buscamos desde o tempo de Saul.
verses.en_web: Also, let us again bring the ark of our God back to us; for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
verses.en_bbe: And let us get back for ourselves the ark of our God: for in the days of Saul we did not go to it for directions.

verses.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.pt: Então toda a congregação disse que assim se fizesse, porque isso pareceu correto aos olhos de todo o povo.
verses.en_web: All the assembly said that they would do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people said they would do so, for it seemed right to them.

verses.en: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
verses.pt: Assim Davi ajuntou a todo Israel, desde Sior do Egito, até chegar a Hamate, para que trouxessem a arca de Deus de Quriate-Jearim.
verses.en_web: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor the brook of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
verses.en_bbe: So David sent for all Israel to come together, from Shihor, the river of Egypt, as far as the way into Hamath, to get the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

verses.en: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
verses.pt: Então Davi subiu com todo Israel a Baalá, que é Quriate-Jearim, em Judá, para dali trazerem acima a arca de Deus, o SENHOR, que habita entre os querubins, a qual é chamada pelo seu nome.
verses.en_web: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
verses.en_bbe: And David went up, with all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim in Judah, to get up from there the ark of God, over which the holy Name is named, the name of the Lord whose place is between the winged ones.

verses.en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
verses.pt: E levaram a arca de Deus da casa de Abinadabe sobre uma carruagem nova, e Uzá e seu irmão guiavam o carro.
verses.en_web: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
verses.en_bbe: And they put the ark of God on a new cart, and took it out of the house of Abinadab; and Uzza and Ahio were the drivers of the cart.

verses.en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.pt: E Davi e todo Israel celebravam diante de Deus com toda força; e com canções, harpas, saltérios, tamboris, címbalos e com trombetas.
verses.en_web: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.en_bbe: Then David and all Israel made melody before God with all their strength, with songs and corded instruments of music, and with brass instruments and horns.

verses.en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.pt: E quando chegaram à eira de Quidom, Uzá estendeu sua mão para segurar a arca, pois os bois tropeçaram.
verses.en_web: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to the grain-floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to keep the ark in its place, for the oxen were slipping.

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.pt: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Uzá, e o feriu, por ele ter estendido sua mão à arca; e morreu ali diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him, because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.en_bbe: And the wrath of the Lord, burning against Uzza, sent destruction on him because he had put his hand on the ark, and death came to him there before God.

verses.en: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
verses.pt: E Davi teve desgosto, porque o SENHOR havia atingido Uzá; por isso ele chamou aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até hoje.
verses.en_web: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And David was angry because of the Lord's outburst of wrath against Uzza, and he gave that place the name Perez-uzza, to this day.

verses.en: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
verses.pt: E Davi temeu a Deus naquele dia, dizendo: Como trarei a mim a arca de Deus?
verses.en_web: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
verses.en_bbe: And so great was David's fear of God that day, that he said, How may I let the ark of God come to me?

verses.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.pt: Por isso Davi não trouxe a arca a si, à cidade de Davi; em vez disso ele a trouxe à casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu.
verses.en_web: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
verses.en_bbe: So David did not let the ark come back to him to the town of David, but had it turned away and put into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
verses.pt: Assim a arca de Deus ficou na casa de Obede-Edom, em sua casa, por três meses; e o SENHOR abençoou a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo quanto ele tinha.
verses.en_web: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
verses.en_bbe: And the ark of God was in the house of Obed-edom for three months; and the Lord sent a blessing on the house of Obed-edom and on all he had.
